sources.title: Cline Cloud Agents
sources.locator: Getting started; Run several agents at once; Check in from your phone; Choose a model; How your work is saved; Steering the agent; Security; Limits; Current limitations
sources.finding: Browser client at app.cline.bot needs a Cline account and GitHub connection; pick repo, branch and model in the Agents tab. Each session gets its own isolated sandbox and cline/ branch, commits and pushes as it goes and opens a PR on request. Sidebar shows working, done and waiting sessions. Works in mobile browsers to read progress, answer questions and send follow-ups. Model can be switched mid-session; providers ClineFree, ClinePass, Cline credits. Idle 15 minutes pauses the sandbox, reopening resumes with workspace intact; work continues after the tab closes. GitHub access limited to the chosen repo. Up to 10 running sessions and 50 new sessions per day; at capacity users are asked to retry. Rules, skills, MCP servers and connectors are not loaded in cloud sessions.

sources.title: Kanban Core Workflow
sources.locator: 1. Create Tasks through 6. Clean Up; Workflow Summary
sources.finding: Cards are created manually or by the sidebar agent, which can create and link cards and start them. Cmd/Ctrl-click links cards; when a linked card completes and is trashed the next linked task starts automatically. Play creates an ephemeral git worktree, symlinks gitignored files such as node_modules (edits to them hit the main copy), runs the agent in its own terminal, and the card shows the latest message or tool call. Detail view shows the agent TUI and a diff with checkpoint-scoped message ranges; inline diff comments go back to the agent. Commit or Open PR prompts the agent, which handles merge conflicts. Trash removes the worktree and keeps a resume ID.

sources.locator: Warning; Prerequisites; Key Capabilities; Agent Compatibility
sources.finding: Kanban is a research preview started with npx kanban from a git repo root; it opens a local board. Works with Cline CLI, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and related runtimes available in settings.

sources.title: Auto Approve & YOLO Mode
sources.locator: How It Works; Permissions; Safe vs Approval-Required Commands; Recommendations; YOLO Mode
sources.finding: Auto-approve is evaluated per tool call by category (read/edit project files, read/edit all files outside workspace, safe/all commands, browser, MCP). The model sets a requires_approval flag per command; there is no fixed allowlist. Optional OS notifications fire when approval is required and when an auto-approved command has run for 30 seconds. Recommended default enables only Read project files. YOLO auto-approves everything, including file operations anywhere and mode transitions.

sources.title: Scheduling
sources.locator: Warning; Schedule Wizard; Creating Schedules with Flags; Managing Schedules; Routing Results
sources.finding: Applies to SDK, CLI and Kanban, not the VS Code/JetBrains extensions. Cron schedules run through the local hub, persist across process restarts and run independently of a terminal session. Options include --timeout, --max-parallel (default 1; runs that come due while busy wait their turn) and --mode (default yolo; scheduled runs approve their own tool calls). Commands list, trigger, pause, resume, update, history (status, duration, tokens, cost), stats (success rate, last failure), delete, export/import. A running connector can post results to a chat.

sources.title: Auto Compact
sources.locator: How It Works; Cost Considerations; Restoring Context
sources.finding: Near the context limit Cline summarizes the conversation and replaces history with the summary; the summarization call shows its cost. Other models fall back to rule-based truncation. Checkpoints can restore pre-summary state.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.finding: CLI and Desktop only. spawn_agent starts a child with its own context and mode tools; in Plan mode shell commands that usually change files are refused but others such as python -c can still write. Approving spawn_agent approves all of the child's tool calls. Child cost adds to the session total.

sources.title: Agent Teams
sources.locator: Starting a Team; Resuming Team Work; Team State
sources.finding: SDK, CLI and Kanban only. /team gives a coordinator tools to add teammates, hand them tasks and collect results via a task board, mailbox and mission log stored in ~/.cline/data/db/teams.db; the team resumes with its session ID.

sources.title: Connectors
sources.locator: Supported Platforms; Slack; Discord Command Reference; Linear; Hook Command Protocol
sources.finding: CLI only. Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, WhatsApp and Linear connectors; each incoming message (via platform webhooks or sockets) creates or continues an agent session and replies in the thread. Discord /abort stops the current task and normal messages steer an active task. Access can be restricted by user ID or a hook command. Connectors need the local hub.

sources.title: CLI Reference
sources.locator: Help Menu; Global Options; auth; mcp; history; hub
sources.finding: Prompts run in yolo mode by default (--auto-approve true); --id resumes a session; -t timeout; -z runs in the background hub; --worktree creates a detached worktree; --acp mode. Commands: auth (provider, key, model), mcp add with --header, history list/export HTML/delete/update, schedule, hub status/start/stop, connect, plugin.

sources.title: Cline Rules
sources.locator: Supported Rule Types; Where Rules Live; Toggling Rules
sources.finding: Reads .clinerules/ and .cline/rules/, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules and AGENTS.md (plus ~/.agents/AGENTS.md) automatically; rules are files, workspace rules can be shared via version control, and each rule has an enable/disable toggle that avoids deleting the file.

sources.title: Skills
sources.finding: Skills load on demand when a request matches their description; each skill has a toggle without deleting its directory.

sources.title: Memory Bank
sources.finding: Memory Bank is a convention of memory-bank/ markdown files plus instructions in custom instructions or a project rules file stored in the repo.

sources.title: Plugins
sources.finding: SDK, CLI and Kanban only. Plugins add custom tools, hooks and slash commands, installed globally or per project with --cwd from file URLs, git, npm or local paths.

sources.title: Cline SDK
sources.finding: @cline/sdk exposes the agent harness with custom tools, plugins, MCP, cron jobs and subagents for embedding and CI.

sources.title: Installing Cline
sources.finding: Desktop: download, choose provider and model, start a session. IDE extension for VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, Windsurf, VSCodium and Antigravity (Open VSX for Windsurf/VSCodium): install, open Cline, authorize.

sources.title: Cline in ACP clients
sources.locator: Intro; Zed; JetBrains IDEs; Neovim; Emacs
sources.finding: cline --acp lets Zed, JetBrains AI Assistant, Neovim clients and Emacs agent-shell drive Cline.

sources.title: cline/cline README
sources.finding: Support links: Docs, Discord, r/cline. Index: SDK, CLI, VS Code extension and Desktop (Tauri shell, Bun sidecar, Next.js UI) are in the repo; JetBrains plugins are not open-sourced.

sources.finding: Apache License 2.0 at the pinned monorepo commit.

sources.title: Remote Development over SSH
sources.locator: Intro; Add a host; How it works
sources.finding: Add a host under Settings > Remote; nothing to install, Cline copies a self-contained helper to ~/.cline/remote/ on first connect and runs edits, commands, Git and MCP remotely. The provider key is sent for the session over the tunnel and not written to remote provider settings. Windows, 32-bit ARM and some Mac hosts are unsupported.

sources.title: Telemetry
sources.finding: Telemetry is on by default in the extensions, Desktop and CLI whether users sign in to a Cline account or use their own API keys; it can be turned off.

sources.title: Prompt Storage
sources.finding: Task conversations are stored locally in ~/.cline/data/tasks/<taskId>/; Enterprise prompt storage optionally syncs them to S3 or R2.

sources.title: Managing Members
sources.finding: Owner/Admin/Member roles; Admins and Owners invite, edit roles and remove members; only Owners remove Admins or transfer ownership.

sources.title: Remote Configuration
sources.finding: Remote configuration controls apply per product: VS Code/JetBrains support rules, skills, providers, organization lock, MCP controls and telemetry; CLI supports only rules/workflows; Desktop none. The table lists Allow YOLO mode as not supported in any product. Members on Desktop or CLI can choose other providers and MCP servers.

sources.title: MCP Overview
sources.finding: MCP servers take credentials via env variables or headers; the CLI can run browser OAuth authorization for remote servers.

sources.title: Authorizing with Cline
sources.finding: Cline usage billing needs sign-in; BYOK pastes a provider API key; local Ollama/LM Studio need no key.

sources.title: Plan & Act
sources.finding: Plan mode reads the codebase and runs searches to plan without modifying files; this page says it cannot execute commands, while the Subagents and Scheduling pages say Plan mode still runs commands that are not refused.

sources.title: Desktop app source
sources.finding: Desktop is a Tauri shell plus a Bun sidecar backend and a Next.js webview UI; the packaged app bundles a self-contained Cline CLI binary that starts the shared Hub. The repo holds src-tauri/ and a desktop-publish workflow.

sources.title: Desktop sidecar git handling
sources.finding: Git features check rev-parse; a non-git workspace returns 'This workspace is not a git repository' and the source-control column shows 'Not a git repository'; worktree creation requires a repo.

sources.title: SDK model request retries
sources.finding: MODEL_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES and MODEL_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES are 3.

sources.title: Configured agents and spawn_agent
sources.finding: Agent definitions in .cline/agents (workspace) or the global agents directory can set providerId, modelId, tools, skills and maxIterations; spawn_agent input is only systemPrompt and task. No per-child reasoning-effort field.

sources.title: Kanban API contract
sources.finding: Each board card has an optional agentId (claude, codex, gemini, opencode, droid, kiro, cline) plus Cline provider/model settings; the board stores dependencies with fromTaskId/toTaskId.

sources.title: Kanban agent task commands
sources.finding: Agents get kanban task list/create/update/trash/link/unlink/start commands; columns are backlog, in_progress, review and done; links show as board arrows and a backlog task becomes ready and auto-starts when its linked prerequisite moves to done.

sources.title: VS Code extension default auto-approval settings
sources.finding: DEFAULT_AUTO_APPROVAL_SETTINGS enables readFiles, readFilesExternally, editFiles, editFilesExternally, useBrowser and useMcp, leaves executeSafeCommands off and enableNotifications false. One global useMcp toggle governs all MCP tools; the code comment says there is no per-tool opt-in.
